svg.title: Branch Lifecycle: Delete, Lock, Protect, Archive
svg.desc: Merged feature branches are deleted automatically, end-of-life release branches are locked read-only, release tags are protected by a tag ruleset, and a whole retired repository is archived instead.
svg.text: Branch Lifecycle: Delete, Lock, Protect, Archive
Match the tool to what must happen to the branch, tag or repository.
Gone the moment the PR merges
Read-only; can still allow fork syncing
Restrict updates and deletions; release app
Everything read-only, issues and PRs too
